Pilot · India

Smit Machchhar

flydubai Flight 10732026Developing story
Flight
flydubai Flight 1073
Date
30 September 2026
Aircraft
Boeing 737 MAX 8
Location
Tabuk, Saudi Arabia

This is a recent event and an investigation is under way. Details may change as more is confirmed.

Captain Smit Machchhar was flying flydubai Flight 1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv when he was attacked in the cockpit by the first officer and the aircraft went into a rapid descent. The UAE Attorney-General has since said the first officer, who used the cockpit crash axe, attempted to carry out a terrorist act. Though seriously injured, Machchhar opened the cockpit door, allowing passengers and crew to restrain the attacker. Off-duty pilots travelling on board took over and the Boeing 737 MAX 8 landed safely at Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, with all 174 passengers alive. Gujarat has announced its Vishisht Gujarat Garima Award and ₹25 lakh for him, and Mankind Pharma ₹1 crore for him and his family. The investigation is ongoing.

Source: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flydubai_Flight_1073 ↗
